card.name: "for" before a duration phrase
card.fires_on: The word "for" right after a dose or an extent, where a length of time or distance comes next. Strongest in the NSAID line "lowest effective dose for the shortest duration".

modes.label: NSAID dosing line
modes.description: "for" after "lowest effective dose" or "dosage", before "the shortest duration".
modes.example: Use the lowest effective dose<< for>> the shortest duration consistent with individual patient treatment

modes.label: Schedule of days
modes.description: "for" after a daily dosing or infusion schedule, before a number of days.
modes.example: by continuous intravenous infusion over 1 hour daily<< for>> 5 days. Delay and reduce dose

modes.label: Distance in geography text
modes.description: "for" after a river's course, before a length in km.
modes.example: parallel to the Atlantic coast<< for>> 80 km, isolating the

card.writes: It lowers words meaning longer, span or exceeding, and favors count and step words, which fits a set duration or amount coming next.
card.plain: It marks the small word "for" that introduces how long or how far something lasts.
